earnings.title: Twilio Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Revenue of $1.56 billion, up 20% reported and 16% organic year-over-year
Non-GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders $267

Net cash provided by operating activities of $389.2 million and free cash flow of $369.6 million, compared with net cash provided by operating activities of $263.6 million and free cash flow of $247.5 million for the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: Q3 was a great quarter for Twilio, driven by disciplined execution and broad-based strength across our product portfolio.

outlook: For the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026, Twilio is initiating a revenue range of $1.595 to $1.605 billion, which implies a reported revenue growth range of 17% to 17.5% and an organic revenue growth range of 11% to 12% year-over-year.
In addition, Twilio is initiating a fourth quarter non-GAAP income from operations range of $300 to $310 million.
Lastly, Twilio expects fourth quarter non-GAAP diluted earnings per share in a range of $1.48 to $1.53, based on non-GAAP weighted average diluted shares outstanding of 163 million.
